Authentic gem along the busy Tran Phu road of Nha Trang beach
Jul 2019 • Couples
My wife and I stumbled onto this place by chance one evening. We loved it so much we went back three more times. 

You know you hit the jack pot when you see a lot of locals eat here but they have menus in Vietnamese, Russian, Chinese and English.

The staff are warm and friendly. Service is fast and the food is excellent. We especially loved the stir fried pumpkin leaves. The seafood was swimming in tanks outside the restaurant so you know it's fresh. We tried the steamed fish, clams , prawns and crab. It was all good. We enjoyed every meal we had there.

Best of all is the price. Give the high end tourist traps a miss and have your meals here. You won't regret it.

Good Vietnamese food at reasonable prices
Dec 2016 • Couples
We are here based on the trip advisor reviews. The menu was in English, Russian & Vietnamese & also had pictures (which I love!). We decided on spring rolls (apparently the standard size serve for spring rolls here is 10), coconut milk roasted chicken & a clay pot with fish.
The fish was excellent, the sauce was complex & complimented the fish (red snapper) perfectly. The chicken was a little on the dry side but the sauce it had been roasted in was very nice. The spring rolls were crunchy & piping hot. The serving sizes, with the exception of the 10 spring rolls were spot on, we had more than enough to eat but certainly weren't looking for dessert.
The service was snappy & the staff although we didn't really speak the same language were nice. For the three dishes, steamed rice & two beers we paid $20AUD (approx) including tip.
Give this place a go, the menu is quiet extensive so I would imagine you could visit a number of times & try something different each time. Sit facing the street so you can people watch as you enjoy your food.

The service is excellent
Jul 2013 • Family

Both the food and service is great, and in addition, it is fair price. The food was terrific. They offer a little of everything in addition to a small selection of a la carte items like eggs in any style, pancakes etc. I highly recommend you visit at least once on your trip.

Excelllent food, excellent service, spacious.
Jan 2011
We ate there several times, and I kept the receipt from one visit: sour soup with fish, mackerel with fish sauce, pork ribs with fish sauce, a vegetable dish, rice, two iced teas; enough for four people (we brought a bottle of wine with us) = 300,000 VND (about $15) in total.

The service is excellent and, a feature I like when I'm traveling, glass-covered, clean tables.

Like many restaurants and coffee shops in Vietnam, it is decorated with reproductions of paintings. A special treat at Than Tuyen is a large reproduction of Ingres' "Grand Odalisque."
